newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong group targets '97 sales at 29 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong group targets '97 sales at 29 trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Ssangyong Group said on Thursday it has set a sales target of 29 trillion won next year, against an estimated 25 trillion won this year.
Total investment in 1997 would be 1.28 trillion won against 1.25 trillion this year, a company statement said.
Of this, 1.12 trillion won would be for facility investment and the rest for research and development.

In all, 560 billion won would be invested in Ssangyong Motor Co for automobile production and storage facility expansion, 300 billion won for Ssangyong Oil Refining Co's xylene centre and heavy oil cracking centre, and 120 billion won for rebuilding facilities at Ssangyong Cement Cement Manufacturing Co Ltd.
